description: GTFS is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Milano. Il GTFS è generato da AMAT a partire dai dati di programmato del servizio di trasporto pubblico locale trasmessi da ATM al Comune di Milano, per il monitoraggio del Contratto di Servizio che regola la gestione del servizio nell’ambito del territorio di Milano e dell'area urbana. Coverage: Comune di Milano. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Milano. Its tags are geo, gtfs, orari, tpl. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
